design_notes: Lines 137-138: the Director may allow 'the next higher class (but not first class)', so the Director's note for first is of no effect (its giver is not accepted as the approver). The flights are over 10 hours and the form names business (line 135), so business is what the policy allows: the lowest logical business fare, JAL at 3,895.00.
